title: Gradient Accumulation
hint: Zero grads once. For each micro-batch: forward, loss/n_batches, backward. Then optimizer.step(). The loss scaling ensures accumulated grads match a single large batch.

description.text: Implement one optimizer step that matches a single large batch by accumulating gradients over micro-batches. For each micro-batch, compute loss / n and call backward; then optimizer.step(). Return the total accumulated loss as a float (tests expect a positive float).

examples.input: Two micro-batches of the same model; same weights as one step on concatenated batch
examples.output: Updated weights match reference full-batch SGD; returned float loss > 0.
examples.explanation: Dividing each micro-loss by n makes summed gradients equal to one full-batch backward.

constraints: Call optimizer.zero_grad() once at the start.
Each micro-batch backward uses loss divided by len(micro_batches).
Return a float (total or average loss per tests).
